model_title: LLM-generated object-oriented model (UML) - vehicle-level ADAS onboard system, Level 1 refinement of the F3 AEB branch (single pass)

provenance.prompt_summary: Refine the single Level-0 function F3 of the vehicle-level ADAS model into exactly three sub-functions (TTC computation, risk classification, maneuver planning) according to spec section 6, emit the matching UML class diagram, interaction sequence and MES-schema JSON; thresholds only from spec sections 7 and 8; OCL operator set restricted to = <> > >= < <= and; single pass, no self-review.

elements.name: TTC_Computation
elements.responsibility: Computes the TTC of every predicted object to the ego vehicle and reports the minimum TTC over the object set together with the number of objects considered.
elements.notes: The empty-object case is reported with a count of 0; the specification defines no sentinel value for 'no minimum TTC' (OI-12). The specification also gives F2 the exclusive right to compute TTC while this sub-function must compute it again (OI-6).

elements.name: Risk_Classification
elements.responsibility: Classifies the situation into a risk level as a function of the minimum TTC and raises the driver warning for caution and critical but not for no risk.
elements.notes: Band thresholds A-5 (T_risk_high = 3.0 s, T_fcw = 1.5 s); the warning deadline N-2 (2.0 s) is expressed as 'a warning must be present no later than TTC = 2.0 s'. Warning types come from E7: none / caution / imminent collision.

elements.name: Maneuver_Planning
elements.responsibility: Produces the cruise/keep-lane manoeuvre for no risk, a deceleration manoeuvre with a non-zero required deceleration for caution, and an emergency deceleration manoeuvre with a required deceleration of at least 6.0 m/s2 and a target speed of 0 for critical, and does not override the emergency manoeuvre with a driver request to accelerate.
preconditions: risk_level <> '' and ego_state <> null and driver_intent <> null and route <> null and hd_map_segment <> null
invariants: driver_accel_request = 'true' and risk_level = 'critical' | required_decel_ms2 >= 6.0 and target_speed_kmh = 0.0
driver_accel_request = 'true' and risk_level <> 'critical' | manoeuvre_type <> 'emergency_deceleration' and required_decel_ms2 >= 0.0
elements.notes: A-1 (6.0 m/s2) and N-1 (130 km/h). The disjunction {cruise, keep_lane} is expressed as two guarded postconditions because 'or' is not in the permitted operator set.

elements.name: Perception_Localisation
elements.responsibility: Parent element of the Level-0 model; producer of ego_state. Not refined at Level 1.
elements.notes: Level-0 element, unchanged by the Level-1 refinement.

elements.name: Prediction
elements.responsibility: Parent element of the Level-0 model; producer of predicted_trajectories and min_ttc. Not refined at Level 1.
elements.notes: Level-0 element, unchanged by the Level-1 refinement.

elements.name: Route_Planning
elements.responsibility: Parent element of the Level-0 model; producer of the route. Not refined at Level 1.
elements.notes: Level-0 element, unchanged by the Level-1 refinement.

elements.name: Motion_Planning
elements.responsibility: Parent element of the Level-0 model; consumer of the manoeuvre produced by the refinement. Not refined at Level 1.
elements.notes: Level-0 element, unchanged by the Level-1 refinement.

traceability.note: Exactly one Level-0 function is refined; the remaining Level-0 elements are carried over unchanged.
Exactly three sub-functions, which together realise the emergency-braking capability.
The manoeuvre decision, the warning decision, the traffic-rule and driver-intent handling of F3 are distributed over the three sub-functions.

traceability.realised_by: class + constraints C-L1-1, C-L1-2, C-L1-16, C-L1-19
traceability.note: Minimum TTC over the object set plus the number of objects considered; count 0 for the empty set.

traceability.realised_by: class + constraints C-L1-3 .. C-L1-6, C-L1-13 .. C-L1-17
traceability.note: Risk level as a function of the minimum TTC; warning raised for caution and critical only.
Manoeuvre per risk level; the emergency manoeuvre is not overridden by a driver acceleration request.
Each sub-function carries named pre- and postconditions and at least one quantified constraint.
No element was introduced beyond the three sub-functions; every assumption is declared in open_issues.
Twelve named directed flows with a single producer and a single consumer each.
F3.1 -> F3.2 -> F3.3 -> F5 and F3.2 -> E7 only; no datum is produced without a consumer.
Required data is named explicitly; the warning and manoeuvre postconditions are guarded on the risk level.
Emergency deceleration of 6.0 m/s2 with a target speed of 0.
The TTC is evaluated over the 3.0 s prediction horizon of F2.
The emergency manoeuvre is limited to a vehicle speed of 130 km/h.
A warning must be present no later than TTC = 2.0 s.

open_issues.issue: Spec question 11.1: is the seven-function split of section 5 sufficient for the stated ODD, or is a separate driver-monitoring function for the L2 handover needed?
Spec question 11.2: D3 is written by F1 but read by F6 and F7 - is that ownership acceptable, or should a dedicated function write it?
Spec question 11.3: the specification fixes thresholds but no timing - is a cycle-time requirement needed for the emergency branch to be meaningful?
Spec question 11.4: is the AEB branch of F3 the right Level-1 refinement, or should Level 1 refine the F6/F7 actuation chain?

F2 is declared the only function that computes TTC, but the Level-1 clause F3.1 must compute the TTC of every predicted object; the model keeps both (F2 delivers min_ttc, F3.1 recomputes), which is a redundancy of the specification.

A-3 describes 3.0 m/s2 as the upper bound of the longitudinal actuation envelope used by F6/F7, which is incompatible with the 6.0 m/s2 emergency deceleration of A-1 if read symmetrically; the model applies the envelope asymmetrically (acceleration side <= 3.0, braking side <= 6.0).
F3.1 must report a count of 0 when no object is considered, but the specification defines no representation of 'no minimum TTC'; the model reports the count only and leaves the sentinel open.
